Notes: Fresh fixed-seed synthetic Transformer unless --safetensors is provided. Prompt IDs are synthetic and fixed; dropout is disabled by Eval. Model creation, upload, route selection and JSON export are outside measured runs. All runs use the specified sampling with the same RNG seed and exactly MaxNewTokens; no EOS stop. KV caches belong to one generation call and are not shared between runs. Token timestamps are measured at the streaming callback; first-token and decode metrics are null if the model only implements the base post-generation callback. Total includes generation cleanup and final lane synchronization. Backend allocation peaks are session-cumulative native buffer allocation peaks, not driver-reported dedicated VRAM. Kernel event durations overlap host wall timings and must not be added to them. Synthetic weights establish throughput, not text quality.
